objects.name: Analytic 2241
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) field device or embedded engineering terminal receiving malformed or exploit-payload data via its built-in communication interface from an external source, designed to exploit a vulnerability in the device's communication stack. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.
